page_title: PAR 1-1 CAG | Parma v Cagliari 27/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+7' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
90+6' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Parma.
90+4' Adam Obert (Cagliari) picks up a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is replaced by Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma).
89' Franco Carboni comes onto the pitch because Emanuele Valeri (Parma) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
89' Cagliari enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Sebastiano Esposito cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) replaces Ibrahim Sulemana.
87' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
86' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
83' 1 - 1 Goal! Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
82' Parma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' Substitution. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) on for Mandela Keita.
73' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.
72' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
67' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) fires the resulting free kick to the top left corner from the edge of the box, but Elia Caprile pulls off a superb save to deny him.
66' Parma earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
65' The whistle blows and Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is booked for an infringement.
63' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Luca Massimi's book.

62' 0 - 1 What a goal! Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the top left corner and behind the goalkeeper.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Semih Kilicsoy departs the field of play to be replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari).
60' Parma have a corner.
60' Luca Massimi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joseph Liteta (Cagliari). Parma have been awarded a free kick.
56' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) has received a yellow card for his foul.

55' Luca Massimi blows his whistle and it's Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Cagliari win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
52' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.

52' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Edoardo Corvi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cagliari.

52' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Christian Ordonez is replaced by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma).
46' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Enrico Delprato will be replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
46' Referee Luca Massimi blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The linesman makes the right call and Parma will have a corner.
44' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
42' Christian Ordonez (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Luca Massimi had a clear view and blows his whistle. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
41' The foul by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) was seen by Luca Massimi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
40' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) receives a yellow card.
40' Parma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

39' Elia Caprile pulls off a great save to deny Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top left corner. The ball goes out for a corner. Parma can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
38' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes.
34' The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.

33' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
30' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
29' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
28' Parma are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. Cagliari will take a free kick near the side line.
24' Parma win a corner.
24' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.

24' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
21' Parma decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
21' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) is booked by the referee.
18' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
17' A pass lands at the feet of Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

15' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Edoardo Corvi pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
14' A pass by Christian Ordonez (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

13' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
12' Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

9' Edoardo Corvi was forced into action to thwart Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marco Palestra (Cagliari). The ball is out of play. Cagliari will take a throw-in.

6' Luca Massimi blows his whistle as Emanuele Valeri (Parma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
4' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Luca Massimi will officiate today.
